<reason>PRO won a competitive debate by making the choice easier: after genuine privacy, safety, third-party, and exclusivity needs are protected at planning, leftover permission barriers on safe publicly funded outputs still fail the public-return test. CON’s translation/formation story was vivid and live, but PRO absorbed it into pre-release exceptions and showed CON’s “justified sharing” still leaves reuse optional. CON never fully explained why residual access-without-reuse is enough once the extra commercial right is no longer needed.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>PRO’s judo on access vs. license, then Rebuttal 2: CON’s own real-need test already requires review, so partner veto cannot remain the default while safe leftover outputs stay locked.</best_rebuttal>
